valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.ev_ebit_withheld_reason: Withheld: the same company (heliopoliscoforhousingdevelopment) is served under two keys, EGS65591C017.CA PE 3.78 and HELI PE 11.05, and they disagree; one market capitalisation cannot be two, so neither multiple is verified. Every market-based multiple of this security is built on that market cap, so none of them is a valuation. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.pegFormula: P/E divided by the growth rate of earnings, the growth rate expressed in percent
valuation.pegGrowthBasis: net profit compound annual growth of 1194.48 percent a year from FY2022 (6.0324e+08) to FY2023 (7.80881e+09), over 1 year
valuation.peEpsSource: net profit for FY2023 divided by the shares on file
valuation.pbFormula: current price / book value per share, where book value per share = total equity / shares outstanding
valuation.pbEquityRow: total_equity on the balance sheet for FY2023
valuation.pbSharesSource: the same 4.00526e+09 shares behind the market capitalisation (static_data\market_EGX.json)
valuation.psFormula: current price / revenue per share, where revenue per share = revenue / shares outstanding
valuation.psRevenueRow: the income statement's revenue line for FY2023, read from the row labelled 'Revenue'
valuation.psSharesSource: the same 4.00526e+09 shares behind the market capitalisation (static_data\market_EGX.json)

derived.ytdBasis: year to date from the last close before 2026 (2025-12-31, 3.6) to the price on 2026-10-05
